title: School accounts office: term fee reminder

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Hello, this is the accounts office of St. Joseph's school. I'm calling about Aarav's second term fee.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: The last date is the fifteenth. After that there is a late fee of two hundred rupees.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Yes, through the parent portal or at the school office counter. Please don't pay to any personal account.
